# phrase: @shanty_drunken_sailor, "What shall we do with a drunken sailor? / Way-ay and up she rises" (Drunken Sailor (No. 7, 'Capstan Chanteys'), sung by Mr. James Tucker at Bristol, Anonymous (traditional), 1914)
# vocal: 17 syllables, free, straight feel, stress x~~x~~x~x~x~~x~x~: a vocal line of 4 bars, sung over sections of 8 bars
# refrain: Joplin's Entertainer, the_entertainer; the tune that comes back, changed on each return
# episodes: template(rondo, episodes=template(canon, subject=ode_to_joy)); what plays between the refrains: a line, the episodes' figure, or sections: a seed's, a stored program's, another form's
tempo 116
key c
swing 0.18

# the drums: the drm_* parts are what the arrangement changes; the kick and the shaker stay put
let kick4 = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_snr = ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_hat = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x x
let shk = x ~ x x ~ x x ~
let the_entertainer_1 = e4 c5 ~ e4 c5 ~ e4 c5 ~ ~ ~ ~ c5 d5 d#5 e5
let the_entertainer_2 = c5 d5 e5 ~ b4 d5 ~ c5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ d4 d#4
let the_entertainer = <the_entertainer_1 the_entertainer_2>
let bach_prelude_c_1 = c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5 c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5
let bach_prelude_c_2 = c4 d4 a4 d5 f5 a4 d5 f5 c4 d4 a4 d5 f5 a4 d5 f5
let bach_prelude_c_3 = b3 d4 g4 d5 f5 g4 d5 f5 b3 d4 g4 d5 f5 g4 d5 f5
let bach_prelude_c_4 = c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5 c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5
let bach_prelude_c = <bach_prelude_c_1 bach_prelude_c_2 bach_prelude_c_3 bach_prelude_c_4>
# the stride: the bass on the beat, the chord after it
let bass_c = c2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ g1 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let bass_g = g1 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let stride_c = ~ ~ ~ ~ [e3, g3, c4] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [e3, g3, c4] ~ ~ ~
let stride_g = ~ ~ ~ ~ [f3, g3, b3] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [f3, g3, b3] ~ ~ ~
# the vocal line: a degree of the key for each syllable, ! on the stressed ones
let vox_a = 1! 2 4 ~ 3! 4 2 ~
let vox_b = 5! 6 8! 6 5! 4 2 ~
let vox_c = 3! 2 1! 1 ~ ~ ~ ~

# refrain (A): the tune that comes back
section refrain 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=80..95 | clap drm_snr kit=drums vel=60..80 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=40..65 | bass <bass_c bass_g> inst=bass vel=70..85
  deck B: harmony <stride_c stride_g> inst=piano vel=50..65 | melody the_entertainer inst=piano vel=55..75
}

# episodes, bound: template(rondo, episodes=template(canon, subject=ode_to_joy))
# the rondo written out, its names starting ep_
let ep_kick4 = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let ep_drm_snr = ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let ep_drm_hat = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x x
let ep_the_entertainer_1 = e4 c5 ~ e4 c5 ~ e4 c5 ~ ~ ~ ~ c5 d5 d#5 e5
let ep_the_entertainer_2 = c5 d5 e5 ~ b4 d5 ~ c5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ d4 d#4
let ep_the_entertainer = <ep_the_entertainer_1 ep_the_entertainer_2>
let ep_bach_prelude_c_1 = c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5 c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5
let ep_bach_prelude_c_2 = c4 d4 a4 d5 f5 a4 d5 f5 c4 d4 a4 d5 f5 a4 d5 f5
let ep_bach_prelude_c_3 = b3 d4 g4 d5 f5 g4 d5 f5 b3 d4 g4 d5 f5 g4 d5 f5
let ep_bach_prelude_c_4 = c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5 c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5
let ep_bach_prelude_c = <ep_bach_prelude_c_1 ep_bach_prelude_c_2 ep_bach_prelude_c_3 ep_bach_prelude_c_4>
# the stride: the bass on the beat, the chord after it

let ep_bass_g = g1 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let ep_stride_c = ~ ~ ~ ~ [e3, g3, c4] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [e3, g3, c4] ~ ~ ~
let ep_stride_g = ~ ~ ~ ~ [f3, g3, b3] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [f3, g3, b3] ~ ~ ~

# ep_refrain (A): the tune that comes back
section ep_refrain 8 bars {
  deck A: kick ep_kick4 kit=drums vel=80..95 | clap ep_drm_snr kit=drums vel=60..80 | hihat ep_drm_hat kit=drums vel=40..65 | bass <ep_bass_c ep_bass_g> inst=bass vel=70..85
  deck B: harmony <ep_stride_c ep_stride_g> inst=piano vel=50..65 | melody ep_the_entertainer inst=piano vel=55..75
}

# episodes, bound: template(canon, subject=ode_to_joy)
# the canon written out, its names starting ep_ep_, in its own key: each of its sections says `key d`
let ep_ep_kick4 = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let ep_ep_drm_hat = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~
let ep_ep_drm_rim = ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~
let ep_ep_pachelbel_ground_1 = d3 ~ ~ ~ a2 ~ ~ ~ b2 ~ ~ ~ f#2 ~ ~ ~
let ep_ep_pachelbel_ground_2 = g2 ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~ g2 ~ ~ ~ a2 ~ ~ ~
let ep_ep_pachelbel_ground = <ep_ep_pachelbel_ground_1 ep_ep_pachelbel_ground_2>
# subject, bound: ode_to_joy
let ep_ep_subject_1 = f#4 ~ ~ ~ f#4 ~ ~ ~ g4 ~ ~ ~ a4 ~ ~ ~
let ep_ep_subject_2 = a4 ~ ~ ~ g4 ~ ~ ~ f#4 ~ ~ ~ e4 ~ ~ ~
let ep_ep_subject_3 = d4 ~ ~ ~ d4 ~ ~ ~ e4 ~ ~ ~ f#4 ~ ~ ~
let ep_ep_subject_4 = f#4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ e4 ~ e4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let ep_ep_subject = <ep_ep_subject_1 ep_ep_subject_2 ep_ep_subject_3 ep_ep_subject_4>
# the copies: a bar behind, and a beat behind; they are made of the theme's own bars, so a change to it moves them too
let ep_ep_follow = <ep_ep_subject_4 ep_ep_subject_1 ep_ep_subject_2 ep_ep_subject_3>
let ep_ep_close = rotate(ep_ep_subject, 4)

# ep_ep_lead: the theme alone over the ground
section ep_ep_lead 8 bars {
  key d
  deck A: kick ep_ep_kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90 | bass ep_ep_pachelbel_ground inst=bass vel=70..85
  deck B: melody ep_ep_subject inst=flute vel=60..80
}

# ep_ep_chase: the copy a bar behind, an octave down
section ep_ep_chase 8 bars {
  key d
  deck A: kick ep_ep_kick4 kit=drums vel=70..84 | hihat ep_ep_drm_hat kit=drums vel=36..54 | bass ep_ep_pachelbel_ground inst=bass vel=60..74
  deck B: melody ep_ep_subject inst=flute vel=52..70 | arp octave(ep_ep_follow, -1) inst=harpsichord vel=40..56
}

# ep_ep_round: three voices, the last a beat behind the first
section ep_ep_round 8 bars {
  key d
  deck A: kick ep_ep_kick4 kit=drums vel=72..86 | hihat ep_ep_drm_hat kit=drums vel=40..58 | snare ep_ep_drm_rim kit=drums-lofi vel=26..44 | bass ep_ep_pachelbel_ground inst=bass vel=60..74
  deck B: melody ep_ep_subject inst=flute vel=50..68 | arp octave(ep_ep_follow, -1) inst=harpsichord vel=38..55 | harmony ep_ep_close inst=strings vel=32..45
}

# sung (C): the phrase, the episode's figure under it
section sung 8 bars {
  master: reverb 0.15
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90 | hihat shk kit=drums vel=30..45 | bass <bass_c bass_g> inst=bass vel=65..80
  deck B: arp bach_prelude_c inst=electric-piano vel=25..40 | melody <vox_a vox_b vox_c ~> inst=kalimba oct=3 vel=24..38
  deck B: sing "what /sh ae l/ we do with a /d r uh ng k uh n - s ay l er/ / way /ay/ and up she /r ie z ii z/" on melody voice=robot-choir
}

# A B A C A ...: the refrain mutated on each return, the episodes between
arrange {
  refrain
  ep_refrain
  ep_ep_lead
  ep_ep_chase
  ~ ep_ep_subject_* rot 2
  ~ ep_the_entertainer_* rot 2 | accent 0.3
  ep_refrain
  @ ep_the_entertainer_* mirror | vel 2
  ~ the_entertainer_* rot 2 | accent 0.3
  refrain
  sung
  @ the_entertainer_* mirror | vel 2
  refrain
  ~ bach_prelude_c_* morph the_entertainer_1 0.2
  ep_refrain
  ~ ep_bach_prelude_c_* morph ep_the_entertainer_1 0.2
  ep_ep_round
  ~ ep_ep_drm_* grow
  ~ ep_ep_subject_* rev | accent 0.25
  ep_ep_round
  ~ ep_ep_subject_* rev
  ~ ep_ep_drm_* decay
  ~ ep_the_entertainer_* up 1
  ep_refrain
  ~ ep_the_entertainer_* down 1
  ep_refrain
  ~ the_entertainer_* up 1
  refrain
  @ vox_* xfer shk
  sung
  ~ the_entertainer_* down 1
  refrain
} loop 2 then end
